title: Guerrilla: The Taking of Patty Hearst

text.lead: Guerrilla: The Taking of Patty Hearst is a 2004 PBS documentary film about the 1974 kidnapping of Patty Hearst by the Symbionese Liberation Army left-wing revolutionary group. It was directed by Robert Stone, and features interviews with Timothy Findley and SLA members Russ Little and Michael Bortin.
text.reception: The film was well received and, based on 46 reviews, has an approval rating of 87% on review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes. The site's consensus reads: "Guerilla is a riveting documentary that chronicles in enlightening fashion the 1974 kidnapping of heiress Patty Hearst."
